book.name: Lukas
book.title: Vaaru Poia tau Lukas Iboode Luk—Luke

content: Ŋeer rughuzaaŋa Yoan igharaat eez pa Yesu Krisi

Tiberius imin kinik to Rom, ve igham pooz irau ndaman saŋavul ve paaŋ, ve ite imin liim pani, ene Pontius Piladus iŋgin taan sirivu to Yudea, ve Erod iŋgin taan sirivu to Galilaia, ve toogha Pilip iŋgin taan sirivu to Iturea ve Trakonitis, ve Lisanius iŋgin taan sirivu to Abilene.
Ve Anas yesuru Kaiapas timin daaba pa yes zeran to watooŋrau. Saawe tana, Yoan tau Sakaria naatu na, ilepleep izi nugh ŋginaaŋa, ve Maaron aliiŋa ilam pani.

Tauvene iburig ilaagh irau nugh naol tau tigheen tigharau yaa Yordan ziige na, ve ivovotia Maaron aliiŋa pa tamtamon ighe tipul ŋgar toozi sasaghati ileple, ve titoor ŋgar toozi imuul ila pa Maaron ve tigham yaa. Leso Maaron ireu sosor toozi.
Ŋgar tau Yoan ighamu, ene itaghon saveeŋ tau igheen ila rau to propet Isaia na. Isaav tauvene:

content.text: Ŋeer ee iboboob izi nugh ŋginaaŋa ighe:
Apaduduŋai eez ta naol ne pani le tiduduuŋ.
Nugh naol isov tau ŋgolopa ŋgolopa na, apavon zi le tizaa raraate.
Ve loloz tomania nugh mbua tisov, aghel zi le tizi raraate.
Eez tau kookakooka na, agharaat zi le tiduduuŋ.
Ve eez naol tau tisaghat na, agharaat zi le popoia.
Leso tamtamon tisov to taan tighit katin uraat tau Maaron pale ighamu leso igham mulin zi.”

content: Saveeŋ tau Yoan ivovotia pa tamtamon

Eval tiina tilala to Yoan tighe i igham yaa pazi. Eemon Yoan isaav pazi ighe: “Yam tane, moot sasaghati natŋa! Sei imbaaŋ payam, ta alam sene? Mindai, yam aghe aŋguaaz taumim pa aatyavyav to Maaron tau ighe ivot ne?

Isaav ighe onoon yam apul ŋgar tsiam sasaghati ileple ve atoor ŋgar tsiam ila pa Maaron, na atotoi anooŋa tooni popoia siriv ivot gha taghita. Yam aghe Abaram paaghu tooni yam. Eemon anumeer gabua tana sov. Pa yau nasaav payam: Maaron, i irau isaav pa maet tane, ve tiburig timin Abaram paaghu tooni.
Alooŋ. Nakavasi to Maaron igheen ila ai pughuzi ve isaŋan wa. Ai tisov tau anoŋazi popoia mako, ene aat nakavasi ighan zi tizi, ve tisik zi tizala yav ighan zi.”
Eval tiina tilooŋ saveeŋ tana, ve tighason Yoan tighe: “Wai, ighe tauvene, pale nigham mindai?”
Yoan iyol aliŋazi ighe: “Tamtamon tau le nonoghiiŋa ru, o igham ee pa iitete tau i le mako na. Ve tamtamon tau le aniiŋ na, i aat itaghon ŋgar raraate mon.”
Zeran siriv to yauŋ takes tila to Yoan paam tighe irughuuz zi. Ve tighasoni tighe: “Mos puughu, yei tane pale nigham mindai?”
Yoan iyol aliŋazi ighe: “Saawe tau ighe ayau takes, na ataghon imin tau daaba to gavman tisaav payam na. Apoi pa maet siriv izala paavo sov.”

Ra zaaba siriv anazi tilam, ve tighasoni tighe: “Ve yei tane, pale nigham mindai?” Yoan iyol aliŋazi ighe: “Agham saghatin tamtamon sov. Ve aparoi zi, ve atombaan zi pa umbuuŋ maet toozi sov. Atuya tsiam tau tigham payam na, ena irau. Aghamu ve lolomim poia pani.”
Saawe tana, eval tiina tighur matazi pa Mesia tighe malau mako pale ilam ivot. Tauvene tighita uraat to Yoan, ve tigham ŋgar ila lolozi tighe: “Mesia aat tauta ene, ma?”

Tauvene Yoan isaav ghazooŋa pazi ighe: “Yau narughuuz gham pa yaa. Eemon ŋeer ee aat ilam murei payau. I tapiri tiina. Iliiv ghau kat. Uraat sorok imin polaaŋ waar to zuzuuŋa to aaghe, ene paam yau poiag irau to nagham pani mako. I pale igham Avuvu Patabuyaaŋ payam tomania yav.

Gabua to tiriiŋ wit, ta i ikisi ila niima ve isasaŋan. Pasaa, i pale igabiiz tamtamon ve ivureer zi imin ŋeer tau ilos wit tooni ve itiri izaa. Leso yaghur ivuvuur wit uuli ilale, ve wit anooŋa timburur tizi. Wit anooŋa tawe, i pale ighur poghania ila ruum to aniiŋ. Eemon wit uuli, i pale ikori ila yav ighani. Yav tawe, irau tirav matini mako. Ighanghan irau saawe.”
Tauvene Yoan ivovotia vaaru poia pa tamtamon, ve ipalot zi pa saveeŋ siriv paam, leso titoor ŋgar toozi.
Erod ighur Yoan iloŋ ila ruum to yavyavuuŋ
Murei, Yoan iyaon Erod tau daaba to taan sirivu to Galilaia na. Pasaa, Erod isan toogha azaawa Erodias ve ivaii, ve igham ŋgar sasaghati siriv paam.
Tauta Erod iseeŋ ŋgar tooni saghati muul, ve ighur Yoan iloŋ ila ruum to yavyavuuŋ.
Yesu igham yaa

Saawe tau eval tiina tigham yaa, Yesu paam ila tomani zi ighe igham yaa. Saawe tau igham yaa ve isuŋsuŋ, sambam ikaak, ve Avuvu Patabuyaaŋ izilam imin mbuun gha izala paavo. Ra saveeŋ sambam ve izilam ighe: “Yau natug eemon ta yo. Yau lolog igheen tsio, ve yo ugham ghau lolog poia kat.”
Pitiiŋ to Yesu puughu tooni
Yesu ndaman tooni irau tamoot ee saŋavul (30), ve i ipaburigin uraat tooni. Tamtamon tigham ŋgar tighe i Yosep naatu. Yosep tane, i Eli naatu.
Eli, i Matat naatu. Matat, i Levi naatu. Levi, i Melki naatu. Melki, i Yanai naatu. Yanai, i Yosep naatu.
Yosep, i Matatias naatu. Matatias, i Amos naatu. Amos, i Naum naatu. Naum, i Esli naatu. Esli, i Nagai naatu.
Nagai, i Maat naatu. Maat, i Matatias naatu. Matatias, i Semein naatu. Semein, i Yosek naatu. Yosek, i Yoda naatu.
Yoda, i Yoanan naatu. Yoanan, i Resa naatu. Resa, i Zerubabel naatu. Zerubabel, i Sealtiel naatu. Sealtiel, i Neri naatu.
Neri, i Melki naatu. Melki, i Adi naatu. Adi, i Kosam naatu. Kosam, i Elmadam naatu. Elmadam, i Er naatu.
Er, i Yosua naatu. Yosua, i Elieser naatu. Elieser, i Yorim naatu. Yorim, i Matat naatu. Matat, i Levi naatu.
Levi, i Simeon naatu. Simeon, i Yuda naatu. Yuda, i Yosep naatu. Yosep, i Yonam naatu. Yonam, i Eliakim naatu.
Eliakim, i Melea naatu. Melea, i Mena naatu. Mena, i Matata naatu. Matata, i Natan naatu. Natan, i David naatu.
David, i Yesi naatu. Yesi, i Obet naatu. Obet, i Boas naatu. Boas, i Salmon naatu. Salmon, i Nason naatu.
Nason, i Aminadap naatu. Aminadap, i Admin naatu. Admin, i Arni naatu. Arni, i Ezron naatu. Ezron, i Peres naatu. Peres, i Yuda naatu.
Yuda, i Yakop naatu. Yakop, i Isak naatu. Isak, i Abaram naatu. Abaram, i Tera naatu. Tera, i Naor naatu.
Naor, i Serug naatu. Serug, i Reu naatu. Reu, i Peleg naatu. Peleg, i Eber naatu. Eber, i Sela naatu.
Sela, i Kainan naatu. Kainan, i Arpaksad naatu. Arpaksad, i Sem naatu. Sem, i Noa naatu. Noa, i Lamek naatu.
Lamek, i Metusela naatu. Metusela, i Enok naatu. Enok, i Yared naatu. Yared, i Malalel naatu. Malalel, i Kenan naatu.
Kenan, i Enos naatu. Enos, i Set naatu. Set, i Adam naatu. Ve Adam, i Maaron naatu.

footnotes.text: Zeran ŋgara siriv tighe yav tau Yoan isavia na, ŋgara tauvene: 1) Yesu pale igabiiz tamtamon ve ighur atuya pazi. 2) Ve siriv tighe yav tane ŋgara, ene tauvene: Yesu pale igharaat tamtamon tooni, ve ipasov ŋgar saghati toozi, imin yav ighan muun tau igheen tomania gol na, leso iŋgalaaŋ kat. 3) Ve siriv tighe yav tane izaa to saawe to Pentekos, tau Avuvu Patabuyaaŋ izilam imin yav.
